author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the release date trailer for Backpack Boy, a puzzle platformer developed by Chuck & Niles Games. Players will take off on a trek and discover a peculiar flashlight that changes the world around them by shining into the past. Explore a seemingly abandoned structure in this puzzle platformer built around mode-swapping. Explore deeper to uncover the mysteries at the heart of the facility. Something is waiting for you… Backpack Boy is launching on August 10 for PC (Steam) and PlayStation.
title: Backpack Boy - Official Release Date Trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
